name: lavaplume-fatestone-enter-x-unpreventable-damage
notes: Lavaplume Fatestone (0w5xyjuczy, GeneratedMacroCode.php enterAbilities["0w5xyjuczy:0"] calls Custom/CardLogic.php's LavaplumeFatestoneEnter(); customDQHandlers["LavaplumeFatestoneResolve"] deals the damage): "Fast Activation.
